questions.q: Why did Jacob not send Benjamin with his brethren?
choices: He was too young to travel
Lest mischief befall him; he was Rachel's last son
questions.explain: With Joseph presumed dead, Benjamin was the last son Jacob had of his beloved wife.

questions.q: Why did Joseph's brethren not know him?
choices: Time had passed, and he blended in among the Egyptians
questions.explain: All twelve tribes looked like the people of Egypt (Genesis 50:10-11).

questions.q: What did the brothers say among themselves, not knowing Joseph understood?
choices: We are verily guilty concerning our brother
questions.explain: Their conscience was activated; he spake unto them by an interpreter.

questions.q: Which brother did Joseph bind and keep?
questions.explain: He took from them Simeon, and bound him before their eyes.
